mixerCosting.title: Mixer grinder costing
mixerCosting.subtitle: Cost and FOB price per piece for each export model, and the plan for one container
mixerCosting.notBuiltBody: There are no costing tables for the export models in the database yet, so no figures are shown here. Nothing on this screen is typed in or copied from a sheet: every figure will come from the books, the bills and the assembly records.
mixerCosting.when: Comes after the owner confirms the models and the costing method

bom.title: Bill of materials per model.
bom.body: Each model's parts and quantities, from the approved assembly BOM.

rates.title: Part rates from purchase bills.
rates.body: The latest posted bill rate of each part, before and with GST.

freight.title: Inward freight and loading.
freight.body: Spread over the pieces of each purchase, so each part's rate carries its share.

labour.title: Labour per piece.
labour.body: From staff duties in the assembly unit and the pieces assembled each month.

overheads.title: Factory cost.
overheads.body: Power, water and other overheads of the assembly unit, per piece.

fob.title: FOB build-up.
fob.body: Parts + factory cost + labour + factory profit + transport + free spares, per piece and model.

container.title: Container plan.
container.body: Cartons × pieces for one container, free spares, and the purchase requests per supplier it creates.

checks.title: Checks.
checks.body: Lines that look counted twice or out of line with the bills are listed for the owner to confirm.

owner.models: Which export models are costed, and their approved BOMs.
owner.sheets: Whether the existing costing sheets are imported as history or only used as a check.
owner.overheads: How factory overheads are spread over the assembly unit.
owner.profit: The factory profit and free-spares percentages to apply.

mixerCosting.usedTitle: Where the figures will come from
mixerCosting.usedBody: These screens already hold the records the costing will use.
